capture_method: headless Chromium (Playwright) against the live pages; public JSON APIs fetched directly where available

www.cbp.gov.role: primary site: travel/entry pages, trusted traveler program copy, port-of-entry directory, newsroom, forms catalog (with PDFs), trade guidance

bwt.cbp.gov.role: Border Wait Times app JSON APIs (crossing directory + frozen wait-time snapshot)

careers.cbp.gov.role: CBP careers pages: career paths, events, featured jobs

www.usajobs.gov.role: CBP job postings featured on careers.cbp.gov

esta.cbp.dhs.gov.role: official ESTA application site: application wizard steps, fee, Visa Waiver Program country list

images.policy: every file fetched from the upstream URL it renders at; no placeholders, no duplicates, no stretching

form_pdfs.policy: the actual CBP form PDFs served by www.cbp.gov, sha256-pinned per form in the catalog

benchmark_users.fixture: approved ESTA (Germany), I-94 record, saved Blaine crossing
conditionally approved Global Entry application, saved San Ysidro crossing + port, I-94 record
pending ESTA application, saved CBP Form 7501, I-94 record

fixtures.note: traveler records (ESTA/I-94/TTP) are deterministic benchmark fixtures keyed to the benchmark users; all catalog/directory/news content is upstream-sourced

determinism.seed: PYTHONHASHSEED=0 python3 seed_data.py at image build time
determinism.verified: byte-identical instance/ vs instance_seed/ after rebuild
